svg.title: Loop Current: pre-Lili geostrophic core width
svg.desc: Author-reported approximate100 km cross-stream span for geostrophic speed at least0.4 m/s, prestorm fields19-23September2002. Zero-reference level at750 m or local bottom. This is not a current footprint, uniform depth layer, seasonal range or width-error interval. No velocity curve reconstructed.

g.text: Loop Current · published geostrophic core span
Fixed speed cutoff: at least 0.4 m/s · author-labeled cross-stream section
About 100 km · reported span, no edge locations inferred
Thermal-wind density analysis · zero reference at 750 m or local bottom.
Upper 300 m core context does not define a uniform width layer.
Source e-folding wording is not adopted as a relative boundary rule.
No width error, seasonal interval, annual extrema or whole-current width.
Source: Uhlhorn (2008), University of Miami dissertation, §2.5.2, p36; Figure2.28, p38.
Independent OSW graphic; source curves and geographic edges not reproduced.
